# Sonarworks

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 6 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Audio-product marketing in black and white: a black nav and footer, Inter display at 44/52 with tight tracking, photo tiles, and full pills for every action, with blue only on a trial and yellow only on a sale badge.

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (public marketing and the login and signup forms; no account created, no card entered). Themes: light.

Sonarworks makes speaker and headphone calibration software. This package covers the public marketing site and the signed-out account on www.sonarworks.com, measured on 19 November 2026. No account was created. No card was entered. The only theme on the pages was light. The CSS viewport was 1169 by 731, device pixel ratio 2.

## Typography

5 styles from `core.typography`. `fontFamily` is the first family of each stack; the full stacks, and properties DESIGN.md has no field for (text case, decoration), are in tokens.json. Families: Inter.

### Fonts (from README.md)

Inter, loaded from fonts.googleapis.com as `Inter:400,500,600,700,900`. The marketing body is `Inter, sans-serif`. The account body is `"Inter var", Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif`. Weight 400 is the default. The wordmark and some footer links use 600 and 700. Inter is licensed under the SIL Open Font License. The tokens name the stack, and the font files are not in this package.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

**Every value is a hand entry.** [raw/](raw) holds no value readings: [raw/readings.json](raw/readings.json) and [raw/viewport.json](raw/viewport.json) record the pages, the viewport and why the screenshot tool failed. The tokens were typed in at capture time from readings that were never saved. On 2026-11-21 the 58 tokens labelled Measured (47), Declared (9) or Derived (2) were relabelled Reconstruction ("entered by hand at capture time; no raw/ file holds this reading"), with the original wording kept after it; the 10 component tokens already carried that label. No value changed. A recapture that writes the readings into raw/ is needed before any of them can be called measured, and `tools/test_tokens.py` fails if a token claims a reading raw/ does not hold.

Secondary text `#96999c` on the white page is 2.86:1. On the black nav it is 7.33:1. Disabled text `#636669` on `#d8d9da` is 4.08:1. Those are the colours read at capture time. The icon is a redraw of the header mark on a black square, not a file the site served. Highlight colours other than trial blue and sale yellow were declared in CSS and not seen painted, except green as a class name on the product page. The error border was not shown. "Inter var" on the account pages and "Inter" on the marketing pages are both loaded as Inter. The 1169px width is the live viewport, not a requested 1440. Phone type (`.text-mobile-lg`, 32/40) was probed, not shown, because the viewport was wide. CookieScript uses Open Sans and is not a product font. No dark theme was measured.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Keep the page black and white.** The nav, footer and primary pills are `#000000` and `#ffffff`. Colour is reserved for a trial pill, a sale badge and status. The home hero in [patterns.md](patterns.md) is the reference, and there is no screenshot.
- **Set display type in Inter 400 at 44/52 with -1.5px tracking.** Headings are not bold. The wordmark is the exception, at weight 600.
- **Use a full pill for every action.** Learn More, Buy now, social continue and the disabled submit all use `9999px` radius. Fields on the account form stay square.
- **Leave a disabled submit grey.** `#d8d9da` with `#636669` text, until the form is valid.
- **Do not invent a dark theme, a shadow, or a focus ring.** None of those were measured. A missing screenshot is a gap, not a prompt to draw stand-in UI.
